rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent stepped mass with a clear dominant object, and it remains legible across the four views rather than collapsing into a single-view trick. The carved void/court is visible and reasonably public, giving the street edge a usable ground response instead of a sealed box. The silhouette is stepped but not arbitrarily tiered; the section feels capacity-bearing enough for neighborhood living, with upper massing that stays subordinate to the base/court logic. There are some signs of thin fragments at the edges and the repair/clipping looks a bit uneven in places, but not enough to break the massing coherence or the program contract. The references support the stepped-hierarchy and active-threshold reading more than any specific style copy.
